notableDrops: Gem drop table access, mithril boots, rune full helm, hard clue scrolls. Superior variant is the Vitreous Jelly.

rating.basis: Warped jellies barraged in the Catacombs (wiki task page). Lower XP than the other barrage tasks (wiki Mortimer strategies). Poor drops.

wilderness.basis: Krystilia: nine jellies in a multi area of the Wilderness Slayer Cave (wiki task page). PK risk.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Turael/Aya 6, Spria 6, Mazchna/Achtryn 6, Vannaka 7, Chaeldar 11, Konar 9, Nieve/Steve 9 and Duradel/Kuradal 9. Needs combat level 15.
note: Any kalphite counts, the Kalphite Queen included.
bestLocation: Kalphite Cave east of Shantay Pass (~20 spawns, tight multi-combat chamber, ideal for cannon). Kalphite Lair is the off-task alternative.
killStyle: cannon + melee (best XP). Stack the chamber and cannon.
weakness: Crush attacks are especially effective against their chitin.
monsterAttackStyle: melee (crush) for workers/soldiers/guardians. Kalphite Queen: first form ranged/magic, second form melee.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee for the standard kalphites (Queen: switch prayers per form).
requiredItems: none (bring desert-appropriate supplies if using the Lair route; soldiers drop waterskins). Slayer helm optional.
notableDrops: Gem drop table, brimstone keys (Konar tasks), ensouled kalphite heads. Kalphite Queen (optional): dragon chainbody, dragon 2h sword, Jar of sand, Kalphite Princess pet.

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 75k XP/h cannoning soldiers, low effort. Cannon runs at a loss.

filler.basis: Judgment from the wiki's Turael task completion tips (Slayer reward point): cannonable, by fairy ring, desert amulet or glory.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Vannaka 7, Chaeldar 12, Konar 3, Nieve/Steve 3, Duradel/Kuradal 4 and Mortimer 10. Needs 70 Slayer and combat level 65.
bestLocation: Iorwerth Dungeon, Prifddinas (14 spawns, drops crystal shards) or Fremennik Slayer Dungeon task-only area (9 spawns). Kurask Lair is the off-task spot.
killStyle: melee with a leaf-bladed weapon (sword/spear/battleaxe), or broad bolts/arrows, or the Magic Dart spell. Nothing else deals any damage.
weakness: Restricted target: only leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart can damage Kurask.
monsterAttackStyle: melee (crush; low accuracy, moderate max hit ~11)
protectionPrayer: none needed usually (low accuracy); Protect from Melee if the King kurask superior spawns.
requiredItems: Required to deal damage: a leaf-bladed weapon (sword/spear/battleaxe), broad bolts/arrows, or Magic Dart. Regular weapons do 0 damage.
notableDrops: Leaf-bladed battleaxe (1/1,026, exclusive), leaf-bladed sword (1/384), mystic robe top (light, 1/512), herbs and seeds. Superior is King kurask.

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 20k XP/h, leaf-bladed weapons only. About 1.2M/h (money making guide).

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Chaeldar 8, Konar 8, Nieve/Steve 8 and Duradel/Kuradal 10. Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal need Reptile Got Ripped first.
note: Brutes and shamans count, and shamans drop the dragon warhammer.
bestLocation: Lizardman Canyon in the Kebos Lowlands (west side is multi-combat; NPC soldiers tank aggro). For shamans/DWH: Lizardman Settlement, Molch, or the Canyon.
killStyle: cannon + melee/ranged for basic lizardmen in the multi canyon. For shamans, melee or ranged and step out of the acidic-pool special.
monsterAttackStyle: mixed (crush melee + ranged for lizardmen/brutes; shamans use magic and drop poison/acid pools). Poisonous.
protectionPrayer: varies: Protect from Missiles vs the ranged lizardmen; Protect from Magic near shamans. No single prayer covers all.
requiredItems: none required; antipoison useful. Xeric's talisman speeds travel to Kebos.
notableDrops: Dragon warhammer (shamans, ~1/5,000), Xeric's talisman (inert), lizardman fang (dragon sword / Kodai insignia), Xerician fabric, brimstone keys (Konar).

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 50k XP/h with a cannon, fast task. Shamans about 1.1M/h (money making guide).

assignedBy: Not assigned on its own since August 2025. Metal dragons: Weight at each master: Konar 15, Nieve/Steve 12 and Duradel/Kuradal 14. Needs combat level 85.
note: Not a task of its own since August 2025. A metal dragon task counts any metal dragon. Mithril dragons drop the dragon full helm.
bestLocation: Ancient Cavern, upper level (7 spawns, single-combat, no cannon).
killStyle: ranged or melee with antifire up (no cannon here). Super antifire + a defender gives higher DPS; it picks physical 60% / magic 40%, with a 20% dragonfire chance on ranged/magic picks.
weakness: Earth spells and dragonbane weapons.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee when meleeing (or Protect from Missiles at range), combined with antifire for the dragonfire.
requiredItems: Antifire protection: super antifire, or anti-dragon shield / dragonfire shield + antifire potion.
notableDrops: Dragon full helm (1/32,768, only source), draconic visage, dragon platelegs/plateskirt, chewed bones (3/128), dragon bones.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Vannaka 5, Chaeldar 12, Konar 7, Nieve/Steve 7, Duradel/Kuradal 9, Krystilia 5 and Mortimer 8. Krystilia needs I Wildy More Slayer first. Needs 80 Slayer and combat level 85. Krystilia's version is in the Wilderness.
note: Greater nechryael in the Catacombs of Kourend count toward the task.
bestLocation: Catacombs of Kourend: greater nechryael in a multi-combat spot (stack and barrage/burst). Alternatives: Slayer Tower basement/top floor (single) and Charred Dungeon.
killStyle: Ice Barrage / Ice Burst multi in the Catacombs for max XP; alternatively cannon + melee, or Emberlight melee (they are demonic).
weakness: Demonbane weapons receive their usual bonuses.
monsterAttackStyle: melee (crush, max hit ~11). Summons death spawns that can hit through Protect from Melee.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (note: their summoned death spawns hit through it).
requiredItems: none required. Emberlight/demonbane and a Slayer helm help. Freezing gear if barraging.
notableDrops: Rune boots, herbs and seeds, combat runes; greater/superior variants drop malicious ashes; imbued heart obtainable via the superior. Superior is the Nechryarch.

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 100k XP/h barraging in the Catacombs, 55k with a cannon and the Venator bow, 40k with melee. Decent profit with melee or venator bow.

wilderness.basis: Krystilia: Wilderness Slayer Cave, multi with a cannon. PK risk.

assignedBy: Not assigned. It can appear on any nechryael task once Bigger and Badder is bought.
note: A superior that can appear on nechryael tasks once Bigger and Badder is bought. It can drop the imbued heart and the eternal gem.
bestLocation: Wherever the Nechryael task is being done: Catacombs of Kourend (greater nechryael, multi) or the Slayer Tower.
killStyle: melee (Protect from Melee) or continue barraging; it summons 3 chaotic death spawns that attack with magic, ranged, and melee (they despawn when it dies).
weakness: Demonbane weapons receive their usual bonuses.
monsterAttackStyle: melee (crush, max hit ~27, very high damage) plus the mixed-style chaotic death spawns it summons
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (the chaotic death spawns still hit through it; kill or tank them).
requiredItems: none required; demonbane/Emberlight and food help due to its high damage.
notableDrops: Imbued heart (~1/440), eternal gem (~1/440), guaranteed malicious ashes, brimstone keys (on Konar tasks). It is the superior (no further superior).

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Konar 5, Nieve/Steve 5 and Duradel/Kuradal 8. Konar, Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal need Seeing Red first. Needs combat level 68.
note: Baby and brutal red dragons count toward the task.
bestLocation: Brimhaven Dungeon (16 spawns, single combat, cannonable; safespot by the black-demon pipe agility shortcut; Karamja Elite Diary notes the hides). Catacombs of Kourend (brutal red dragons) is a multi alternative.
killStyle: melee (Protect from Melee) or ranged; cannon to speed kills at Brimhaven
weakness: Water spells: 50% elemental weakness. Dragonbane weapons also receive their usual bonuses.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (dragonfire still requires antifire protection)
requiredItems: Anti-dragon shield or antifire potion (or both) for dragonfire. Not covered by a Slayer helmet.
notableDrops: Dragon bones + red dragonhide (always), dragon javelin heads (1/128 post-MM2), ensouled dragon head

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 30k XP/h, should not be unlocked, far from a bank. About 240k/h, brutal reds 440k/h (money making guide).

assignedBy: Not assigned on its own since August 2025. Metal dragons: Weight at each master: Konar 15, Nieve/Steve 12 and Duradel/Kuradal 14. Needs combat level 85.
note: Not a task of its own since August 2025. A metal dragon task counts any metal dragon. Rune dragons need Dragon Slayer II.
bestLocation: Lithkren Vault eastern chamber (5 spawns, single combat). Access via rowboat or digsite pendant after Dragon Slayer II.
killStyle: melee (Protect from Missiles) or ranged; insulated boots to blunt the electric special
weakness: Earth spells and dragonbane weapons.
monsterAttackStyle: mixed - melee, ranged, magic, dragonfire, plus a life-leech ranged special and an electric-bolt DoT
protectionPrayer: Protect from Missiles (mitigates the life-leech ranged special)
requiredItems: Antifire protection for dragonfire; insulated boots strongly recommended to cut electric-bolt damage. Not covered by a Slayer helmet.
notableDrops: Draconic visage (1/8,000), dragon limbs (1/800), dragon metal lump (1/5,000), rune bars/dragon gear

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Chaeldar 7, Konar 5, Nieve/Steve 5 and Duradel/Kuradal 7. Needs 72 Slayer and combat level 70.
bestLocation: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (22 spawns, single combat). Safespot available; 82 Agility (77 w/ summer pie) shortcut nearby.
killStyle: ranged or melee; safespot with ranged to avoid the icy breath
monsterAttackStyle: mixed - melee, ranged, and icy (magic) breath
protectionPrayer: Protect from Missiles (or safespot to avoid attacks entirely)
requiredItems: Mandatory: elemental/mind/dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield (cuts icy breath from 50+ to 10; ancient wyvern shield also gives freeze immunity). Not covered by a Slayer helmet.
notableDrops: Draconic visage (1/10,000), granite legs (1/512), dragon platelegs/plateskirt (1/512), magic logs, battlestaves

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 15k XP/h. About 1.4M/h (money making guide).

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Konar 7, Nieve/Steve 7, Duradel/Kuradal 9 and Mortimer 8. Needs 93 Slayer and combat level 85.
note: The Thermonuclear smoke devil counts toward the task.
bestLocation: Smoke Devil Dungeon (multi-combat) - place cannon centrally and barrage stacks. Thermonuclear smoke devil boss also counts toward the task.
killStyle: barrage/burst (magic) with a cannon to lure
protectionPrayer: Protect from Missiles (negates their attacks)
requiredItems: Mandatory: facemask, Slayer helmet, or Slayer helmet (i) to deal any damage. A Slayer helmet covers this.
notableDrops: Occult necklace (1/512), dragon chainbody (1/32,768); Smoke battlestaff only from the boss

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 150k XP/h barraging, 55k with melee, the best XP in the game. Drops cover the runes, occult necklace.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Vannaka 8, Chaeldar 12, Nieve/Steve 6, Duradel/Kuradal 7 and Krystilia 6. Needs 63 Slayer and combat level 60, and 60 Strength or 60 Agility. Krystilia's version is in the Wilderness.
note: The God Wars Dungeon needs Death Plateau. Spiritual rangers need 63 Slayer, warriors 68 and mages 83.
bestLocation: God Wars Dungeon - Zamorak's Fortress or the Zaros/Ancient Prison room (Zaros variants need The Frozen Door). Wear god-aligned items so that faction ignores you.
killStyle: melee/ranged/magic (no cannon allowed in GWD)
monsterAttackStyle: mixed by type - warriors melee, rangers ranged, mages magic
protectionPrayer: Protect from the relevant style of the variant you target (Melee/Missiles/Magic)
requiredItems: God-aligned equipment (e.g. Zamorakian items) to avoid that faction's aggression. The Frozen Door miniquest for Zaros variants. Nothing needed to deal damage.
notableDrops: Dragon boots (Spiritual mages only), assorted god-themed and low-value drops

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 25k XP/h, skip. Spiritual mages about 370k/h (money making guide).

wilderness.basis: Krystilia: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only, extremely long, block (wiki Krystilia strategies).

assignedBy: Not assigned on its own since August 2025. Metal dragons: Weight at each master: Konar 15, Nieve/Steve 12 and Duradel/Kuradal 14. Needs combat level 85.
note: Not a task of its own since August 2025. A metal dragon task counts any metal dragon.
bestLocation: Brimhaven Dungeon slayer-only area (9 spawns, cannonable) or general dungeon (4). Catacombs of Kourend (2, level 274, not cannonable).
killStyle: ranged/magic (they won't chase) or melee w/ Protect from Melee; cannon works in Brimhaven
weakness: Earth spells and dragonbane weapons.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (plus antifire for the breath)
requiredItems: Anti-dragon or dragonfire shield + antifire potion for dragonfire. Not covered by a Slayer helmet.
notableDrops: Draconic visage (1/10,000), dragon platelegs/plateskirt (1/512), steel bars (noted with Karamja Elite Diary)

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Nieve/Steve 8 and Duradel/Kuradal 8. Needs combat level 85.
note: Lunar Isle needs Lunar Diplomacy started.
bestLocation: Lunar Isle - northern spawns (multi, cannon + ranged safespot next to the hill) or the southern melee-only Suqah (Guthan's for zero food).
killStyle: ranged + cannon (north) or melee (south)
monsterAttackStyle: mixed - stab (melee) and weak water/ice magic (hybrid variant)
protectionPrayer: Protect from Magic vs hybrid variants (or Melee for the melee-only ones)
requiredItems: Seal of passage to use the bank unless Dream Mentor is done or Elite Fremennik Diary earned. Nothing needed to deal damage.
notableDrops: Suqah hide, Suqah tooth, big bones, gem-table access (uncut gems, loop/tooth key halves)

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 55k XP/h with a cannon, fast unextended. Drops do not cover the cannon.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Vannaka 7, Chaeldar 11, Konar 6, Nieve/Steve 6 and Duradel/Kuradal 6. Needs combat level 60.
bestLocation: Mountain trolls at Death Plateau (games necklace teleport) or Trollheim; ice trolls at northern Jatizso/Neitiznot (multi-combat, better drops, 100% fire weakness).
killStyle: melee/ranged with a cannon (trolls have short aggression range); fire spells shine on ice trolls
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (mountain trolls)
requiredItems: None mandatory. Neitiznot shield helps vs ice troll females. Cannon highly recommended.
notableDrops: Big bones, ensouled troll head, assorted low-value drops

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 50k XP/h cannoning ice trolls, the trip to Jatizso is slow. Drops cover part of the cannon.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Vannaka 8, Chaeldar 10, Konar 3, Nieve/Steve 3 and Mortimer 10. Needs 55 Slayer and combat level 60.
bestLocation: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (the only location). Fastest access is a Slayer ring teleport; fairy ring AJR is the next-best route. The level-61 Agility shortcut from the basilisk chamber reaches the Turoth chamber, and the east-wall rocks/path to Kurasks can be used as safespots.
killStyle: Leaf-bladed battleaxe + defender is the best simple melee setup and can train Strength on an aggressive style; broad/amethyst broad bolts or broad arrows are easy safespot alternatives; Magic Dart also works.
weakness: Leafy restriction: ordinary weapons, ammunition and spells deal no damage. Use a leaf-bladed melee weapon, broad/amethyst broad ammunition, or Magic Dart. The leaf-bladed battleaxe also gains 17.5% damage against Turoth and stacks with a black mask/Slayer helmet.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee, or take no damage by safespotting with an allowed ranged or Magic Dart setup.
requiredItems: Mandatory: leaf-bladed battleaxe/sword/spear, broad or amethyst broad bolts/arrows, or Magic Dart with a compatible staff. Normal weapons such as an abyssal dagger or whip cannot damage Turoth.
cannon: banned (the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon does not permit cannons)
notableDrops: Leaf-bladed sword, light mystic robe bottom, herbs and farming seeds, hard clue scrolls. Superior Spiked Turoth can roll superior uniques.

rating.basis: Leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammo or Magic Dart only (wiki task page). Herb drops. A slow single combat task (wiki Mortimer strategies).

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Chaeldar 8, Nieve/Steve 10 and Duradel/Kuradal 10. Chaeldar, Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal need Hot Stuff first.
note: You can fight TzTok-Jad instead, or TzKal-Zuk once you have killed him. Failing the attempt cancels the task.
bestLocation: Mor Ul Rek inner city (Fire Cape needed to enter) - barrage TzHaar-Ket; or safespot melee Ket/Xil in the outer city.
killStyle: barrage/burst (magic) on stacked Ket, or melee/ranged safespot
weakness: Water spells are effective against many TzHaar variants; exact strength varies by creature.
monsterAttackStyle: mixed - Hur/Ket melee, Xil melee or ranged, Mej magic
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (when bursting TzHaar-Ket)
requiredItems: Fire Cape to enter the inner city. Nothing needed to deal damage; Slayer helmet not required.
notableDrops: Obsidian armour (from level-221 TzHaar-Ket), tokkul, uncut gems, onyx bolt tips (with Ring of Wealth)

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 100k XP/h with blood barrage, drops cover the runes. Entering and leaving the Fight Caves ends the task early.

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Mazchna/Achtryn 6, Vannaka 7, Chaeldar 6, Konar 4, Nieve/Steve 6 and Duradel/Kuradal 8. Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve and Duradel/Kuradal need Actual Vampyre Slayer first. Needs combat level 35.
note: Vyrewatch need A Taste of Hope, and vyrewatch sentinels need Sins of the Father.
bestLocation: Vyrewatch Sentinels in Darkmeyer (19 spawns, blood shards) - best. Slepe (10, safespottable) or Meiyerditch (61) as alternatives.
killStyle: melee, with a tier 3 flail for vyrewatch and sentinels
weakness: Vampyre-specific weapons: Ivandis or Blisterwood flails bypass their damage restrictions; ordinary weapons are ineffective against higher-tier Vyrewatch.
protectionPrayer: varies (Protect from Melee generally); no single prayer negates them
requiredItems: Depends on the vampyre. Feral vampyres take damage from any weapon. Vampyre juvinates need a silver weapon, or any weapon at half damage with Efaritay's aid. Vyrewatch, Vyrewatch Sentinels and venators need a tier 3 weapon: the Ivandis flail, a blisterwood flail, sickle or stakes, the hallowed flail or the sunspear. Efaritay's aid and a Slayer helmet do not cover them.
notableDrops: Blood shard (Vyrewatch Sentinels, high value), vampyre dust, coins

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 15k XP/h with special weapons only. Vyrewatch sentinels about 930k/h (money making guide).

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Chaeldar 6, Konar 10, Nieve/Steve 7, Duradel/Kuradal 8 and Mortimer 10. Needs 62 Slayer.
note: With 62 Sailing, Wyrmscraig Cavern lets you cannon them.
bestLocation: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon lower level (single combat, no cannon). Neypotzli wyrmlings is a multi/cannonable alternative but drops only wyrmling bones.
killStyle: ranged with Protect from Magic (wyrms only use magic when hit from range)
weakness: Earth spells: 50% elemental weakness on standard Wyrms. Dragonbane weapons also receive their usual bonuses.
protectionPrayer: Protect from Magic
requiredItems: Mandatory: boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots to survive the dungeon floor heat (unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is done). Not covered by a Slayer helmet.
notableDrops: Dragon harpoon (1/2,000 on task, 1/10,000 off), dragon sword, wyrm bones (~2k ea)

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 35k XP/h, 53k cannoning in Wyrmscraig Cavern with 62 Sailing. About 700k/h (money making guide).

assignedBy: Weight at each master: Chaeldar 7, Konar 2, Nieve/Steve 2 and Duradel/Kuradal 2. Needs 57 Slayer and combat level 60.
bestLocation: Ancient zygomites in the Mushroom Forest, Fossil Island (27 spawns, cannonable, safespot). Zanaris zygomites (levels 74/86) are alternatives.
killStyle: ranged/magic in high-magic-defence gear (+ cannon); finish each one with fungicide spray
protectionPrayer: Protect from Melee (their melee is the more accurate attack)
requiredItems: Mandatory: fungicide spray - spray a zygomite once it drops below ~8 HP or it revives. Refills from Slayer masters. Not covered by a Slayer helmet.
notableDrops: Grimy ranarr weed (lvl 74) / grimy snapdragon (lvl 86), nature runes, supercompost, brimstone key (Konar tasks)

rating.basis: Wiki Slayer training: 10k XP/h, fast task, skip.
